text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 435 October 11, 1974
CREATING PREPARATORY COMMITTEES FOR THE THIRD MINISTERIAL MEETING OF THE
GROUP OF 77 OF THE UNITED NATIONS CONFERENCE ON TRADE AND DEVELOPMENT
WHEREAS, the Philippine Government has offered to host the Third Ministerial Meeting of the UNCTAD
Group of 77 to beheld in Manila in February 1976;
WHEREAS, the hosting of the abovementioned Meeting is beneficial to the Philippines in many ways,
namely: promote cooperation among developing countries, particularly during this period when the
international economic system is being reformed and heavily subjected to strains and stresses; provide the
developing countries an opportunity to see first-hand the progress achieved under the New Society; promote
trade and tourism; and strengthen the position of Manila as an important conference center in Asia;
WHEREAS, it is extremely important that such a meeting of considerable magnitude and importance be
efficiently organized and that all agencies concerned, governmental and non- governmental, should cooperate
to ensure its success:
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby order the creation of the following committees for the Third Ministerial
Meeting of the UNCTAD Group of 77 in order that the meeting may be organized and run efficiently and
bring the desired benefits to the country:
1. Committee on Conference Matters. The Committee shall be in charge of preparations for conference
facilities, including the conference site. It shall be under the Chairmanship of Assistant Executive Secretary
Roberto V. Reyes and Vice-Chairmanship of Ambassador Leticia R. Shahani, Assistant Secretary for United
Nations Affairs and International Conferences.
2. Committee on Substantive Matters. The Committee shall be under the Chairmanship of Undersecretary of
Foreign Affairs Manuel Collantes and Vice-Chairmanship of Ambassador Hortencio J. Brillantes, who is
hereby designated Senior Consultant thereof. The Secretary of Foreign Affairs shall establish a system of per
diems and allowances for secretariat and other services.
The Chairman of each Committee is hereby empowered to request any agency of the Philippine Government
to assist in the discharge of the Committees' duties and responsibilities and to appoint such personnel
including consultants it may require for the purpose.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
